items.h: Coco in Concert: Boston Pops Scores Pixar's Film Live Today
items.sum: The Boston Pops play the score of Coco at Symphony Hall for a 1:30 p.m. matinee.

items.h: Igor Levit Brings an All-Beethoven Recital to Symphony Hall
items.sum: A Sunday afternoon recital traces Beethoven's arc, ending with the Waldstein Sonata.

items.h: Friday Organ Recitals at Trinity Church in Copley Square
items.sum: Midday organ recitals on Nov. 6, 13 and 20, with no charge for admission.

items.h: Walk-In Piano Stations Open at Boston Public Library Branches
items.sum: Piano stations at four branches run through Nov. 30 on a walk-in basis.

items.h: Halloween Night in Boston: What to Expect
items.sum: A Saturday Halloween, a sunny weekend in the forecast, costume shows all over town, and the clocks fall back overnight.

items.h: Green Line shuts down across downtown for Halloween weekend
items.sum: No Green Line trains run between North Station and Kenmore, Babcock Street or Heath Street this weekend, with shuttles and some bus routes at no fare, and the T warns trips may run 25 minutes longer.

items.h: Noah Kahan adds four Fenway Park shows for 2027
items.sum: The singer-songwriter returns to Fenway Park for concerts on May 29, May 30, June 1 and June 2.

items.h: Bostonhenge sunset lines up with Back Bay streets this week
items.sum: The twice-a-year moment when the setting sun aligns with Back Bay buildings is back, with tips on where and when to watch.

items.h: Hello, Old Friend brings Detroit-style pizza to West Roxbury
items.sum: The pizza maker known for pop-ups and a Roslindale residency is opening its own West Roxbury location.

items.h: High-end Japanese restaurant group from a James Beard winner heading to Boston
items.sum: An acclaimed chef's upscale Japanese restaurant chain is expanding into the Boston market.
